Chapter 8: Limitations & Chapter 9: Future Enhancements

Chapter 8: System Limitations

While the AssetDesk platform successfully satisfies all functional specifications defined in the engineering contract, specific technical boundaries were established to maintain academic scope feasibility within the 15-week internship timeframe:

Table 8.1: Identified Technical and Operational System Limitations
No. Limitation Dimension Technical Description & Operational Impact
1 Single Organization Tenancy The database architecture enforces a single corporate perimeter; multi-tenant database partitioning and cross-organization isolation are not supported.
2 No Binary File Attachments Support tickets and threaded comment discussions accept text-only payloads; uploading diagnostic crash dumps, log files, or photos is unsupported.
3 External SMTP Configuration Automated license expiry warnings require external SMTP transport credentials; failure in third-party mail gateways prevents email alert delivery.
4 Manual Barcode / Serial Entry Device onboarding requires manual keyboard input of asset tags and serial numbers; hardware optical barcode or QR scanner integration is absent.
5 Monolingual Interface The user interface, error messages, and compliance reports are implemented exclusively in English without internationalization (i18n) localization.
6 Free-Tier Cloud Container Wakeup When deployed on non-dedicated free-tier hosting platforms (e.g., Render/Railway), idle container sleep introduces initial cold-start latency.

Chapter 9: Future Enhancements

The modular 3-tier architecture and decoupled RESTful design of AssetDesk provide a solid foundation for enterprise scaling. Planned enhancements include:

Table 9.1: Strategic Roadmap for Future Architectural Enhancements
No. Planned Enhancement Technical Implementation Strategy & Targeted Organizational Benefit
1 Cloud Object Attachment Storage Integrate AWS S3 / Cloudinary SDK with pre-signed URLs to enable uploading invoice PDFs, device photos, and crash dumps directly on tickets.
2 Mobile Optical Barcode / QR Scanner Implement HTML5 WebRTC camera APIs to enable mobile barcode and QR scanning, streamlining physical inventory audits and asset verification.
3 Multi-Tier Approval Workflows Add configurable multi-level managerial authorization chains for high-value hardware requisitions before technician fulfillment.
4 Enterprise SSO & Directory Sync Incorporate SAML 2.0 and OAuth2 (Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID) for single sign-on authentication and automated user provisioning.
5 Native Mobile Companion App Develop a cross-platform React Native mobile app delivering instant push notifications for critical SLA breaches to field technicians.
6 Financial Depreciation Engine Introduce automated accounting routines calculating straight-line and reducing-balance hardware depreciation for corporate tax reporting.
